artworks.title: Theseus Plunges Sciron into the Sea (kylix)
artworks.description: Douris' Berlin kylix from Vulci: Theseus kicks Sciron from the cliff toward the waiting turtle — the Isthmus brigand's death as Attic red-figure justice.

artworks.title: Theseus and Sciron (metope)
artworks.description: Metope from the Athenian Treasury at Delphi: Theseus against Sciron — the cliff-robber carved into Panhellenic stone for every pilgrim to see.

artworks.title: Theseus, Sciron and Procrustes (cup)
artworks.description: Louvre cup G104: Sciron among Theseus' Isthmus labours beside Procrustes — the cliff and the bed as paired Athenian propaganda.

artworks.title: Theseus and Sciron
artworks.description: Nineteenth-century illustration of Theseus casting Sciron from the Scironian rocks — the turtle below, the brigand mid-fall.

popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Theseus' road-clearing on the Isthmus — Sciron forced to wash feet, then kicked to the turtle.

popCulture.title: Sciron
popCulture.description: The Megarian cliff-robber who made travellers wash his feet — until Theseus sent him to the turtle.
